# Pinstripe

> Pinstripe is the coding standard for the Wayne State app stack: shared presets for Pint, PHPStan, Larastan, Rector, ESLint and Prettier, cut once and worn by every repo.

**Sharp code. Every line.**

The coding standard for the Wayne State app stack: shared presets for Pint, PHPStan (with Larastan for Laravel), Rector,
and ESLint with Prettier. Your app points at them and adds only its own exceptions. Pinstripe is to code what a good
suit is to a job interview: nobody notices it, everybody notices when it's missing.

Checks: `composer ci` (the same command runs on GitLab and GitHub).

Development happens on Wayne State's GitLab; this repository is a release mirror. Changes land there first.

Front page: [`site/index.html`](https://github.com/waynestate/pinstripe/blob/HEAD/site/index.html), a static tailor's shop you can open in a browser or serve from `site/`.
On Citadel it is served by the raw-PHP deploy layer in [`deploy/`](https://github.com/waynestate/pinstripe/blob/HEAD/deploy/): a Squire kit whose front controller serves `site/` behind HELMET's security headers. For local development, keep serving `site/` directly.

Every page below is Markdown. The HTML pages send the same Markdown to a client that asks for `text/markdown`. Written by Squire's agent-ready kit from the README and the pages; do not edit.

## Pages

- [Pinstripe: Sharp code. Every line.](https://pinstripe.apps.wayne.edu/index.md): Pinstripe is the coding standard for the Wayne State app stack: shared presets for Pint, PHPStan, Larastan, Rector, ESLint and Prettier, cut once and worn by every repo.

## Prompts

- [Get started with Pinstripe](https://pinstripe.apps.wayne.edu/#prompt-get-started): Measure the app, say which pieces fit, and chalk out every file before a stitch goes in. The prompt itself is in https://pinstripe.apps.wayne.edu/index.md.
- [Pinstripe in a raw PHP app](https://pinstripe.apps.wayne.edu/#prompt-raw-php): Pint with PER, PHPStan at level 8, the three Composer scripts, and a baseline if the old cloth needs one. The prompt itself is in https://pinstripe.apps.wayne.edu/index.md.
- [Pinstripe in a Laravel app](https://pinstripe.apps.wayne.edu/#prompt-laravel): The Laravel Pint preset and PHPStan with the Larastan lining, for Blade and Inertia apps alike. The prompt itself is in https://pinstripe.apps.wayne.edu/index.md.
- [Pinstripe on the Vue side](https://pinstripe.apps.wayne.edu/#prompt-vue): ESLint with vuejs-accessibility and Prettier for the layout, on whichever app the Vue front end lives in. The prompt itself is in https://pinstripe.apps.wayne.edu/index.md.
